<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ar" dir="rtl">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<title>Site Weird 😜</title>
<style>
  body {
    margin: 0;
    height: 100vh;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ff6ec4, #7873f5, #4ade80);
    background-size: 400% 400%;
    animation: gradientMove 8s ease infinite;
    font-family: 'Comic Sans MS', cursive, sans-serif;
    text-align: center;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  @keyframes gradientMove {
    0% { background-position: 0% 50%; }
    50% { background-position: 100% 50%; }
    100% { background-position: 0% 50%; }
  }

  h1 {
    color: white;
    text-shadow: 2px 2px 6px black;
    font-size: 2.2em;
    margin-bottom: 30px;
  }

  #magicBtn {
    padding: 20px 40px;
    font-size: 1.5em;
    border: none;
    border-radius: 50px;
    background: #111;
    color: #fff;
    cursor: pointer;
    box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
    transition: transform 0.2s ease, background 0.3s ease;
  }

  #magicBtn:hover {
    transform: scale(1.1) rotate(-2deg);
    background: #ff004c;
  }

  #imageBox {
    margin-top: 30px;
    display: none;
  }

  #imageBox.show {
    display: block;
    animation: pop 0.5s ease;
  }

  @keyframes pop {
    0% { transform: scale(0) rotate(0deg); opacity: 0; }
    60% { transform: scale(1.2) rotate(10deg); opacity: 1; }
    100% { transform: scale(1) rotate(0deg); }
  }

  #imageBox img {
    filter: drop-shadow(0 0 15px rgba(255,255,255,0.8));
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>

  <button id="magicBtn" onclick="showImage()">بعد مني 🙅‍♂️</button>

  <div id="imageBox">
    <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="surprise" style="max-width: 280px; border-radius: 20px; border: 4px solid white;">
    <p style="color:white; text-shadow:1px 1px 4px black; font-size:1.2em;">😂 Aji le3no chitan aghzali 🌹</p>
  </div>

<script>
  function showImage() {
    const box = document.getElementById('imageBox');
    box.classList.add('show');
  }
</script>

</body>
</html>
